name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-chart
description: Xiaowei chart delivery (mermaid_build + svg_build). Mermaid sources compile to an HTML harness with the inline mermaid runtime; SVG sources are sanitized at write time (root <svg>, no <script> / on* attrs). Both persist as kind: 'chart' to the artifact registry.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && cp lib/types/index.js lib/index.js && cp lib/types/index.d.ts lib/index.d.ts
